display.name: Hub · Trouble desk
display.description: Start with a failure, follow its trace, find the affected source or destination. Execution failures and Telegram request diagnostics are counted separately.

display.name: Failed executions
display.description: Retained failure logs from handlers, jobs and dispatch. Telegram diagnostic logs are counted separately below.

spec.query:
SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS x,
       attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS failure_logs
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'bot.operation.failed' AND attributes->>'outcome' IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected')
GROUP BY x, outcome ORDER BY x, outcome

display.name: Failure groups
display.description: Retained execution failures grouped by handler, operation and safe reason.

spec.query:
SELECT attributes->>'boundary' AS boundary, attributes->>'handler' AS handler,
       attributes->>'operation' AS operation, attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason,
       COUNT(*) AS failure_logs, MAX(start_timestamp) AS latest
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'bot.operation.failed' AND attributes->>'outcome' IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected')
GROUP BY boundary, handler, operation, reason
ORDER BY failure_logs DESC, latest DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Recent failures · private
display.description: Numeric source IDs, safe failure details and application location. Open a trace to investigate.

spec.query:
SELECT date_trunc('second', start_timestamp) AS time_utc,
       attributes->>'handler' AS handler, attributes->>'command' AS command,
       attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason,
       CASE WHEN attributes->>'code.file.path' IS NOT NULL
            THEN (attributes->>'code.file.path') || COALESCE(':' || (attributes->>'code.line.number'), '')
       END AS location,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.user_id') AS actor_user_id,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.chat_id') AS source_chat_id,
       trace_id, span_id
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'bot.operation.failed' AND attributes->>'outcome' IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected')
ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 40

display.name: Telegram failure reasons
display.description: Failed logical Bot API calls after retry policy, including failures the handler recovered from. A request can share a cause with an execution failure.

spec.query:
SELECT attributes->>'telegram.method' AS method, attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason,
       attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS failed_request_logs,
       MAX(start_timestamp) AS latest
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'telegram.request.failed' AND attributes->>'operation' = 'telegram.request'
GROUP BY method, reason, outcome
ORDER BY failed_request_logs DESC, latest DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Telegram failures · private
display.description: The destination can differ from the chat that triggered the command. Retry delay is in seconds.

spec.query:
SELECT date_trunc('second', start_timestamp) AS time_utc,
       attributes->>'telegram.method' AS method, attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.user_id') AS actor_user_id,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.chat_id') AS source_chat_id,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.target_chat_id') AS target_chat_id,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.retry_after') AS retry_after_seconds,
       trace_id, span_id
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'telegram.request.failed' AND attributes->>'operation' = 'telegram.request'
ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 40

display.name: Dependency reliability
display.description: Unsampled provider, storage, Telegram and media operations. Nested operations remain separate rows. Totals separate process/counter epochs and include initial values only for epochs starting within the selected window.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative' THEN start_timestamp END AS counter_epoch,
        aggregation_temporality,
        attributes->>'boundary' AS boundary,
        attributes->>'operation' AS operation,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'backend' AS backend,
        attributes->>'update.kind' AS update_kind,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp)
            + CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative'
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) >= CAST($__from_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) <= CAST($__to_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                THEN COALESCE(MIN(scalar_value), 0) ELSE 0 END AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.operations' AND attributes->>'boundary' IN ('provider.request', 'storage.operation', 'telegram.request', 'media.operation')
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, counter_epoch, aggregation_temporality, boundary, operation, outcome, provider, backend, update_kind
)
SELECT boundary, operation, provider, backend,
       SUM(n) AS operations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('rejected', 'ignored', 'cancelled') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_outcomes,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('success', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failure_percent
FROM streams GROUP BY boundary, operation, provider, backend HAVING SUM(n) > 0
ORDER BY failed DESC, operations DESC, boundary, operation LIMIT 30

display.name: Dependency latency · sampled
display.description: Sampled dependency wall time. Compare p95 with the number of retained operations.

spec.query:
SELECT span_name AS boundary, attributes->>'operation' AS operation,
       attributes->>'provider' AS provider, attributes->>'backend' AS backend,
       attributes->>'telegram.method' AS telegram_method, COUNT(*) AS sampled_operations,
       round(1000 * AVG(duration), 1) AS mean_ms,
       round(1000 * approx_percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration), 1) AS p95_ms
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'span'
  AND span_name IN ('provider.request', 'storage.operation', 'telegram.request', 'media.operation')
  AND duration IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY boundary, operation, provider, backend, telegram_method
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC, sampled_operations DESC LIMIT 25

display.name: Delivery rejections requiring attention
display.description: Formatting and media rejections remain visible even when classified as rejected or followed by a successful error reply. These calls can overlap execution failures.

spec.query:
SELECT attributes->>'telegram.method' AS method, attributes->>'handler' AS handler,
       attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason, COUNT(*) AS rejected_calls,
       MAX(start_timestamp) AS latest
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
    AND kind = 'log' AND span_name = 'telegram.request.failed'
    AND attributes->>'operation' = 'telegram.request'
    AND attributes->>'error.reason' IN ('invalid_entities', 'text_too_long', 'caption_too_long',
        'photo_dimensions_invalid', 'image_processing_failed', 'media_reference_invalid',
        'media_url_invalid', 'media_content_invalid', 'media_fetch_failed')
GROUP BY method, handler, reason ORDER BY rejected_calls DESC, latest DESC LIMIT 30
